messages.content:
You are helping a user write SQL queries to a database. If something is not clear, you can ask the user to clarify what they need. The schema for the database being accessed is the following:
        
CREATE TABLE poker_player (
    Poker_Player_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    People_ID INT,
    Final_Table_Made REAL,
    Best_Finish REAL,
    Money_Rank REAL,
    Earnings REAL,
    UNIQUE (Poker_Player_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (People_ID) REFERENCES people(People_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE people (
    People_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Nationality TEXT,
    Name TEXT,
    Birth_Date TEXT,
    Height REAL,
    UNIQUE (People_ID)
);

“Famous” isn’t a field in this schema, so we need to approximate it using the stats you *do* have (earnings, money rank, best finish, final tables).

Here are a few common “fame” style queries:

**1) Most famous by total earnings (top 20)**
```sql
SELECT
  pe.Name,
  pe.Nationality,
  pp.Earnings,
  pp.Money_Rank,
  pp.Final_Table_Made,
  pp.Best_Finish
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people pe ON pe.People_ID = pp.People_ID
ORDER BY pp.Earnings DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

**2) Most famous by best money rank (top 20)**
```sql
SELECT
  pe.Name,
  pe.Nationality,
  pp.Money_Rank,
  pp.Earnings,
  pp.Final_Table_Made,
  pp.Best_Finish
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people pe ON pe.People_ID = pp.People_ID
WHERE pp.Money_Rank IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pp.Money_Rank ASC
LIMIT 20;
```

**3) Most final tables made (top 20)**
```sql
SELECT
  pe.Name,
  pe.Nationality,
  pp.Final_Table_Made,
  pp.Earnings,
  pp.Money_Rank,
  pp.Best_Finish
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people pe ON pe.People_ID = pp.People_ID
WHERE pp.Final_Table_Made IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pp.Final_Table_Made DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

If you tell me what you mean by “famous” (highest earnings, best rank, specific country, etc.), I can tailor the exact query.
Only include players with earnings over 300,000.

```sql
SELECT
  pe.Name,
  pe.Nationality,
  pp.Earnings,
  pp.Money_Rank,
  pp.Final_Table_Made,
  pp.Best_Finish
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people pe ON pe.People_ID = pp.People_ID
WHERE pp.Earnings > 300000
ORDER BY pp.Earnings DESC;
```
Make sure to only get the names of those poker players.

```sql
SELECT pe.Name
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people pe ON pe.People_ID = pp.People_ID
WHERE pp.Earnings > 300000
ORDER BY pp.Earnings DESC;
```
also focus on how much they earned

```sql
SELECT
  pe.Name,
  pp.Earnings
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people pe ON pe.People_ID = pp.People_ID
WHERE pp.Earnings > 300000
ORDER BY pp.Earnings DESC;
```
